messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Canary promotion paused for release v3.6.0 -> observations: p95 latency +24% (baseline 180ms -> 223ms), error-rate +11% over baseline in us-west. Suggested action: staged fallback by region, pin dedicated pools back to v3.5.2 for affected pools; auto-rollback threshold = >10% error-rate sustained for 20m. See /runbooks/canary-fallback.
maria: ack. thanks. who has manual rollback authority for us-west? we should avoid a full revert if we can traffic-slice to older model and keep eu running.
sam: I can take US-W manual rollback. I'll do staged pin + traffic shift to v3.5.2 for dedicated pools only. leaving hosted canary at 10% until we confirm.
kevin: no DB or schema changes in this deploy, confirmed. it's inference-only (kv-cache/quant flags). safe to pin binaries.
carla: sending a quick note to affected customers (dedicated) now: "Investigating a transient latency/regression; we may revert to previous model for affected pools. Will update in 30m." I'll add a line in release notes draft for rollback record.
maria: sam — use these commands (ops-runbook):
```
redwoodctl rollout pause --release v3.6.0 --region us-west
redwoodctl traffic shift --from=canary --to=stable --percent=60 --region=us-west
redwoodctl pool pin --pool dedicated-usw --version v3.5.2
```
After that verify p95 and error-rate over next 15m.
sam: running now. stderr/logs look clean so far. will paste progress.
sam: ran the commands, traffic at 60%->stable, pool pinned. starting 15m monitor window. ping @maria @kevin if anything spikes.
deploy-bot: action taken: rollout paused, traffic-shift initiated, pool pin job started (job id: 3b7f2c). Monitoring window started.
ops-bot: FYI pinned dedicated-usw -> v3.5.2. Notifying accounts with reserved capacity in us-west. Ticket created: INT-4721.
kevin: can we capture kernel/quant flags used on v3.6.0 instance? need for repro. grab /var/log/serve/config.json from nodes in pinned pool.
sam: grabbing logs now, will upload to INT-4721.
maria: comms plan: if metrics don't fall below threshold after 20m, we perform full rollback for dedicated pools in us-west and open a rollback postmortem. Carla to push customer note after final decision.
carla: drafting final customer email template now — will send once sam confirms monitoring.
sam: at +18m error-rate trending down to +4% and p95 back to +190ms. looks like partial traffic shift helped. holding for 2 more minutes.
maria: good. keep pin in place for 6h while we investigate; do not unpin until root cause understood. we'll update release notes: revert applied to dedicated-usw, canary stayed at 10%.
carla: sent customer update to affected list; included support link and ETA for investigation.
kevin: collecting config dumps and KV cache metrics, uploading to INT-4721.
sam: closing the action for manual rollback execution (me). leaving note: manual_staged_pin_usw_by_sam
maria: thanks team. I'll open a follow-up thread for RCA and timeline for re-release once findings from INT-4721 are in. :thumbsup:
